To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the concept of the Data Exchange Agent System, as a part of the Agent System for automatic simulation model building, is an innovative and effective solution for automatic data gathering and simulation model construction in the field of discrete event simulation of production processes.

it is possible to create a data exchange agent system for automatic construction of simulation models of manufacturing processes, and that this system is going to provide a number of benefits to the users of simulation models.

the agent system will be able to: 1) automatically collect information about the manufacturing processes, 2) automatically construct simulation models of these processes, 3) update these models, and 4) apply changes to data (resulting from a simulation) into the PDM and ERP systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with

development of a system that will be able to independently build and constantly update simulation models of manufacturing processes, and also to automatically apply changes to class ERP and PDL systems.
the development of an intelligent system for the automatic simulation model creation of a manufacturing process.

the development of an innovative method of simulation model construction for manufacturing processes, which is going to be based on a concept of an autonomous agent system, which will be capable of automatic model construction and data updating.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system is going to provide a tool which will allow to build simulation models of production processes with a higher level of detail and accuracy than is possible today.

the agent system is going be a universal, flexible and intelligent tool, allowing to build simulation models of production processes with high precision and without the necessity of any manual data processing, which will allow to use the simulation in practice in a much wider scope than today.
this system is a solution for a problem of the lack of information in simulation models, and a tool for automatic model updating.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have created an architecture of the agent system, and we have developed an algorithm of data collection, as well as a prototype of a simulation model of a manufacturing process, which is a part of a system.
the proposed concept of a data exchange agent system is going not only to improve efficiency of simulation models construction but also the quality of the simulation results.
we have developed the first version of a system that allows to automatically build a simulation model of the production process, and that the system is ready to use in the industry.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the agent system is going not only to collect and update data from the ERP system but will also be capable of collecting information from the PDM system.
a simulation model of a manufacturing process can be built without the need to use any simulation modeling software, but only on the basis of a set of data collected from ERP and PDM class systems.

it is possible to build a system that will be able to independently collect and process information necessary for construction of simulation models, and to automatically update them in a way that allows them to be as close as possible to the real processes.
